sanskrit_shloka:
अकर्तृत्वमभोक्तृत्वं स्वात्मनो मन्यते यदा ।
तदा क्षीणा भवन्त्येव समस्ताश्चित्तवृत्तयः ॥ १८-५१॥
transliteration:
akartṛtvamabhoktṛtvaṃ svātmano manyate yadā .
tadā kṣīṇā bhavantyeva samastāścittavṛttayaḥ .. 18-51..
translation: When one considers the self to be non-doer and non-enjoyer, then all the modifications of the mind dissolve.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: When one considers the self to be non-doer and non-enjoyer, then all the modifications of the mind dissolve.

sanskrit_shloka:
उच्छृङ्खलाप्यकृतिका स्थितिर्धीरस्य राजते ।
न तु सस्पृहचित्तस्य शान्तिर्मूढस्य कृत्रिमा ॥ १८-५२॥
transliteration:
ucchṛṅkhalāpyakṛtikā sthitirdhīrasya rājate .
na tu saspṛhacittasya śāntirmūḍhasya kṛtrimā .. 18-52..
translation: The unrestrained and effortless state of the wise shines, but the peace of the deluded, filled with desires, is artificial.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The unrestrained and effortless state of the wise shines, but the peace of the deluded, filled with desires, is artificial.

sanskrit_shloka:
विलसन्ति महाभोगैर्विशन्ति गिरिगह्वरान् ।
निरस्तकल्पना धीरा अबद्धा मुक्तबुद्धयः ॥ १८-५३॥
transliteration:
vilasanti mahābhogairviśanti girigahvarān .
nirastakalpanā dhīrā abaddhā muktabuddhayaḥ .. 18-53..
translation: The wise, free from imagination, unbound in mind, enjoy great pleasures or enter mountain caves.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The wise, free from imagination, unbound in mind, enjoy great pleasures or enter mountain caves.

sanskrit_shloka:
श्रोत्रियं देवतां तीर्थमङ्गनां भूपतिं प्रियम् ।
दृष्ट्वा सम्पूज्य धीरस्य न कापि हृदि वासना ॥ १८-५४॥
transliteration:
śrotriyaṃ devatāṃ tīrthamaṅganāṃ bhūpatiṃ priyam .
dṛṣṭvā sampūjya dhīrasya na kāpi hṛdi vāsanā .. 18-54..
translation: Upon seeing and worshipping a scholar, deity, sacred place, woman, king, or beloved, the wise have no impression or desire left in the heart.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Upon seeing and worshipping a scholar, deity, sacred place, woman, king, or beloved, the wise have no impression or desire left in the heart.

sanskrit_shloka:
भृत्यैः पुत्रैः कलत्रैश्च दौहित्रैश्चापि गोत्रजैः ।
विहस्य धिक्कृतो योगी न याति विकृतिं मनाक् ॥ १८-५५॥
transliteration:
bhṛtyaiḥ putraiḥ kalatraiśca dauhitraiścāpi gotrajaiḥ .
vihasya dhikkṛto yogī na yāti vikṛtiṃ manāk .. 18-55..
translation: Even if ridiculed by servants, sons, wives, grandsons, and relatives, the yogi does not undergo even the slightest disturbance.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Even if ridiculed by servants, sons, wives, grandsons, and relatives, the yogi does not undergo even the slightest disturbance.

sanskrit_shloka:
सन्तुष्टोऽपि न सन्तुष्टः खिन्नोऽपि न च खिद्यते ।
तस्याश्चर्यदशां तां तां तादृशा एव जानते ॥ १८-५६॥
transliteration:
santuṣṭo'pi na santuṣṭaḥ khinno'pi na ca khidyate .
tasyāścaryadaśāṃ tāṃ tāṃ tādṛśā eva jānate .. 18-56..
translation: Though content, not content; though sorrowful, not distressed—such wondrous states are known only to those of the same kind.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Though content, not content; though sorrowful, not distressed—such wondrous states are known only to those of the same kind.

sanskrit_shloka:
कर्तव्यतैव संसारो न तां पश्यन्ति सूरयः ।
शून्याकारा निराकारा निर्विकारा निरामयाः ॥ १८-५७॥
transliteration:
kartavyataiva saṃsāro na tāṃ paśyanti sūrayaḥ .
śūnyākārā nirākārā nirvikārā nirāmayāḥ .. 18-57..
translation: The wise do not see worldly existence in the sense of duty, being empty in form, formless, changeless, and free from afflictions.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The wise do not see worldly existence in the sense of duty, being empty in form, formless, changeless, and free from afflictions.

sanskrit_shloka:
अकुर्वन्नपि सङ्क्षोभाद् व्यग्रः सर्वत्र मूढधीः ।
कुर्वन्नपि तु कृत्यानि कुशलो हि निराकुलः ॥ १८-५८॥
transliteration:
akurvannapi saṅkṣobhād vyagraḥ sarvatra mūḍhadhīḥ .
kurvannapi tu kṛtyāni kuśalo hi nirākulaḥ .. 18-58..
translation: Even while not doing anything, the confused mind remains restless from disturbance, but the skillful remains unperturbed even while performing actions.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Even while not doing anything, the confused mind remains restless from disturbance, but the skillful remains unperturbed even while performing actions.

sanskrit_shloka:
सुखमास्ते सुखं शेते सुखमायाति याति च ।
सुखं वक्ति सुखं भुङ्क्ते व्यवहारेऽपि शान्तधीः ॥ १८-५९॥
transliteration:
sukhamāste sukhaṃ śete sukhamāyāti yāti ca .
sukhaṃ vakti sukhaṃ bhuṅkte vyavahāre'pi śāntadhīḥ .. 18-59..
translation: Happily, he sits, lies down, comes, goes, speaks, eats; even in worldly activity, the one with a peaceful mind is at ease.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Happily, he sits, lies down, comes, goes, speaks, eats; even in worldly activity, the one with a peaceful mind is at ease.

sanskrit_shloka:
स्वभावाद्यस्य नैवार्तिर्लोकवद् व्यवहारिणः ।
महाह्रद इवाक्षोभ्यो गतक्लेशः सुशोभते ॥ १८-६०॥
transliteration:
svabhāvādyasya naivārtirlokavad vyavahāriṇaḥ .
mahāhrada ivākṣobhyo gatakleśaḥ suśobhate .. 18-60..
translation: By nature, the one who is undisturbed, even while engaging in daily life like others, shines beautifully like a great lake, free from suffering.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: By nature, the one who is undisturbed, even while engaging in daily life like others, shines beautifully like a great lake, free from suffering.

sanskrit_shloka:
निवृत्तिरपि मूढस्य प्रवृत्ति रुपजायते ।
प्रवृत्तिरपि धीरस्य निवृत्तिफलभागिनी ॥ १८-६१॥
transliteration:
nivṛttirapi mūḍhasya pravṛtti rupajāyate .
pravṛttirapi dhīrasya nivṛttiphalabhāginī .. 18-61..
translation: Even the renunciation of the ignorant appears as engagement, while even the engagement of the wise leads to the fruits of renunciation.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Even the renunciation of the ignorant appears as engagement, while even the engagement of the wise leads to the fruits of renunciation.

sanskrit_shloka:
परिग्रहेषु वैराग्यं प्रायो मूढस्य दृश्यते ।
देहे विगलिताशस्य क्व रागः क्व विरागता ॥ १८-६२॥
transliteration:
parigraheṣu vairāgyaṃ prāyo mūḍhasya dṛśyate .
dehe vigalitāśasya kva rāgaḥ kva virāgatā .. 18-62..
translation: Dispassion toward possessions is usually seen in the ignorant, but for one who has transcended desires in the body, where is attachment and where is dispassion?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Dispassion toward possessions is usually seen in the ignorant, but for one who has transcended desires in the body, where is attachment and where is dispassion?

sanskrit_shloka:
भावनाभावनासक्ता दृष्टिर्मूढस्य सर्वदा ।
भाव्यभावनया सा तु स्वस्थस्यादृष्टिरूपिणी ॥ १८-६३॥
transliteration:
bhāvanābhāvanāsaktā dṛṣṭirmūḍhasya sarvadā .
bhāvyabhāvanayā sā tu svasthasyādṛṣṭirūpiṇī .. 18-63..
translation: The ignorant are always attached to imagination or non-imagination, but for the wise, real contemplation manifests as a form of non-vision.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The ignorant are always attached to imagination or non-imagination, but for the wise, real contemplation manifests as a form of non-vision.

sanskrit_shloka:
सर्वारम्भेषु निष्कामो यश्चरेद् बालवन् मुनिः ।
न लेपस्तस्य शुद्धस्य क्रियमाणेऽपि कर्मणि ॥ १८-६४॥
transliteration:
sarvārambheṣu niṣkāmo yaścared bālavan muniḥ .
na lepastasya śuddhasya kriyamāṇe'pi karmaṇi .. 18-64..
translation: The sage who acts without desire, like a child, is not tainted by actions, even while engaged in them, due to his pure nature.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The sage who acts without desire, like a child, is not tainted by actions, even while engaged in them, due to his pure nature.

sanskrit_shloka:
स एव धन्य आत्मज्ञः सर्वभावेषु यः समः ।
पश्यन् श‍ृण्वन् स्पृशन् जिघ्रन्न् अश्नन्निस्तर्षमानसः ॥ १८-६५॥
transliteration:
sa eva dhanya ātmajñaḥ sarvabhāveṣu yaḥ samaḥ .
paśyan śṛṇvan spṛśan jighrann aśnannistarṣamānasaḥ .. 18-65..
translation: He is truly blessed, the knower of the self, who remains equal in all situations, whether seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, or eating, with a mind free from cravings.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: He is truly blessed, the knower of the self, who remains equal in all situations, whether seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, or eating, with a mind free from cravings.

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व संसारः क्व चाभासः क्व साध्यं क्व च साधनम् ।
आकाशस्येव धीरस्य निर्विकल्पस्य सर्वदा ॥ १८-६६॥
transliteration:
kva saṃsāraḥ kva cābhāsaḥ kva sādhyaṃ kva ca sādhanam .
ākāśasyeva dhīrasya nirvikalpasya sarvadā .. 18-66..
translation: Where is worldly existence, appearance, the goal, or practice, for the wise one, always free from distinctions, like the sky?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where is worldly existence, appearance, the goal, or practice, for the wise one, always free from distinctions, like the sky?

sanskrit_shloka:
स जयत्यर्थसंन्यासी पूर्णस्वरसविग्रहः ।
अकृत्रिमोऽनवच्छिन्ने समाधिर्यस्य वर्तते ॥ १८-६७॥
transliteration:
sa jayatyarthasaṃnyāsī pūrṇasvarasavigrahaḥ .
akṛtrimo'navacchinne samādhiryasya vartate .. 18-67..
translation: Victorious is the one who has renounced all purposes, embodying fullness by nature, whose spontaneous and uninterrupted absorption in the self remains constant.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Victorious is the one who has renounced all purposes, embodying fullness by nature, whose spontaneous and uninterrupted absorption in the self remains constant.

sanskrit_shloka:
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन ज्ञाततत्त्वो महाशयः ।
भोगमोक्षनिराकाङ्क्षी सदा सर्वत्र नीरसः ॥ १८-६८॥
transliteration:
bahunātra kimuktena jñātatattvo mahāśayaḥ .
bhogamokṣanirākāṅkṣī sadā sarvatra nīrasaḥ .. 18-68..
translation: What more needs to be said? The great soul who knows the truth, always free from desire for enjoyment or liberation, is uninterested in all things.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: What more needs to be said? The great soul who knows the truth, always free from desire for enjoyment or liberation, is uninterested in all things.

sanskrit_shloka:
महदादि जगद्द्वैतं नाममात्रविजृम्भितम् ।
विहाय शुद्धबोधस्य किं कृत्यमवशिष्यते ॥ १८-६९॥
transliteration:
mahadādi jagaddvaitaṃ nāmamātravijṛmbhitam .
vihāya śuddhabodhasya kiṃ kṛtyamavaśiṣyate .. 18-69..
translation: The world of duality, starting from the Great Principle, is merely a manifestation of names. For the pure consciousness, what duty remains after abandoning this?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The world of duality, starting from the Great Principle, is merely a manifestation of names. For the pure consciousness, what duty remains after abandoning this?

sanskrit_shloka:
भ्रमभूतमिदं सर्वं किञ्चिन्नास्तीति निश्चयी ।
अलक्ष्यस्फुरणः शुद्धः स्वभावेनैव शाम्यति ॥ १८-७०॥
transliteration:
bhramabhūtamidaṃ sarvaṃ kiñcinnāstīti niścayī .
alakṣyasphuraṇaḥ śuddhaḥ svabhāvenaiva śāmyati .. 18-70..
translation: One who is certain that everything in this world is nothing but an illusion and that nothing truly exists, finds that the pure and imperceptible consciousness naturally comes to rest and attains peace.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: One who is certain that everything in this world is nothing but an illusion and that nothing truly exists, finds that the pure and imperceptible consciousness naturally comes to rest and attains peace.

sanskrit_shloka:
शुद्धस्फुरणरूपस्य दृश्यभावमपश्यतः ।
क्व विधिः क्व च वैराग्यं क्व त्यागः क्व शमोऽपि वा ॥ १८-७१॥
transliteration:
śuddhasphuraṇarūpasya dṛśyabhāvamapaśyataḥ .
kva vidhiḥ kva ca vairāgyaṃ kva tyāgaḥ kva śamo'pi vā .. 18-71..
translation: For the one who perceives nothing in the pure radiant nature, where is the rule, dispassion, renunciation, or even tranquility?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: For the one who perceives nothing in the pure radiant nature, where is the rule, dispassion, renunciation, or even tranquility?

sanskrit_shloka:
स्फुरतोऽनन्तरूपेण प्रकृतिं च न पश्यतः ।
क्व बन्धः क्व च वा मोक्षः क्व हर्षः क्व विषादिता ॥ १८-७२॥
transliteration:
sphurato'nantarūpeṇa prakṛtiṃ ca na paśyataḥ .
kva bandhaḥ kva ca vā mokṣaḥ kva harṣaḥ kva viṣāditā .. 18-72..
translation: For the one who shines in infinite forms and does not see nature, where is bondage, where is liberation, where is joy, and where is sorrow?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: For the one who shines in infinite forms and does not see nature, where is bondage, where is liberation, where is joy, and where is sorrow?

sanskrit_shloka:
बुद्धिपर्यन्तसंसारे मायामात्रं विवर्तते ।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारो निष्कामः शोभते बुधः ॥ १८-७३॥
transliteration:
buddhiparyantasaṃsāre māyāmātraṃ vivartate .
nirmamo nirahaṅkāro niṣkāmaḥ śobhate budhaḥ .. 18-73..
translation: In the worldly existence that extends only to the mind, illusion manifests. The wise one, free from ownership, ego, and desires, shines.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: In the worldly existence that extends only to the mind, illusion manifests. The wise one, free from ownership, ego, and desires, shines.

sanskrit_shloka:
अक्षयं गतसन्तापमात्मानं पश्यतो मुनेः ।
क्व विद्या च क्व वा विश्वं क्व देहोऽहं ममेति वा ॥ १८-७४॥
transliteration:
akṣayaṃ gatasantāpamātmānaṃ paśyato muneḥ .
kva vidyā ca kva vā viśvaṃ kva deho'haṃ mameti vā .. 18-74..
translation: For the sage who sees the imperishable self, free from sorrow, where is knowledge, where is the world, where is the body, and where is the sense of "I" and "mine"?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: For the sage who sees the imperishable self, free from sorrow, where is knowledge, where is the world, where is the body, and where is the sense of "I" and "mine"?

sanskrit_shloka:
निरोधादीनि कर्माणि जहाति जडधीर्यदि ।
मनोरथान् प्रलापांश्च कर्तुमाप्नोत्यतत्क्षणात् ॥ १८-७५॥
transliteration:
nirodhādīni karmāṇi jahāti jaḍadhīryadi .
manorathān pralāpāṃśca kartumāpnotyatatkṣaṇāt .. 18-75..
translation: If the dull-witted one renounces control and other actions, they immediately fall into desires and delusions.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: If the dull-witted one renounces control and other actions, they immediately fall into desires and delusions.

sanskrit_shloka:
मन्दः श्रुत्वापि तद्वस्तु न जहाति विमूढताम् ।
निर्विकल्पो बहिर्यत्नादन्तर्विषयलालसः ॥ १८-७६॥
transliteration:
mandaḥ śrutvāpi tadvastu na jahāti vimūḍhatām .
nirvikalpo bahiryatnādantarviṣayalālasaḥ .. 18-76..
translation: Even after hearing of that reality, the ignorant one does not abandon his ignorance. Though outwardly he appears as if without doubt, inwardly he is still full of desires for sense objects.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Even after hearing of that reality, the ignorant one does not abandon his ignorance. Though outwardly he appears as if without doubt, inwardly he is still full of desires for sense objects.

sanskrit_shloka:
ज्ञानाद् गलितकर्मा यो लोकदृष्ट्यापि कर्मकृत् ।
नाप्नोत्यवसरं कर्तुं वक्तुमेव न किञ्चन ॥ १८-७७॥
transliteration:
jñānād galitakarmā yo lokadṛṣṭyāpi karmakṛt .
nāpnotyavasaraṃ kartuṃ vaktumeva na kiñcana .. 18-77..
translation: One whose actions have fallen away due to knowledge, though appearing to act in the eyes of the world, does not get the opportunity to act or speak anything.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: One whose actions have fallen away due to knowledge, though appearing to act in the eyes of the world, does not get the opportunity to act or speak anything.

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व तमः क्व प्रकाशो वा हानं क्व च न किञ्चन ।
निर्विकारस्य धीरस्य निरातङ्कस्य सर्वदा ॥ १८-७८॥
transliteration:
kva tamaḥ kva prakāśo vā hānaṃ kva ca na kiñcana .
nirvikārasya dhīrasya nirātaṅkasya sarvadā .. 18-78..
translation: Where is darkness, and where is light? What is there to abandon, and what is there not to abandon? For the wise one who is unchanging and always fearless, there is nothing.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where is darkness, and where is light? What is there to abandon, and what is there not to abandon? For the wise one who is unchanging and always fearless, there is nothing.

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व धैर्यं क्व विवेकित्वं क्व निरातङ्कतापि वा ।
अनिर्वाच्यस्वभावस्य निःस्वभावस्य योगिनः ॥ १८-७९॥
transliteration:
kva dhairyaṃ kva vivekitvaṃ kva nirātaṅkatāpi vā .
anirvācyasvabhāvasya niḥsvabhāvasya yoginaḥ .. 18-79..
translation: Where is courage, where is discernment, and where is fearlessness? For the yogi whose nature is beyond expression and who is devoid of any nature, these have no meaning.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Where is courage, where is discernment, and where is fearlessness? For the yogi whose nature is beyond expression and who is devoid of any nature, these have no meaning.

sanskrit_shloka:
न स्वर्गो नैव नरको जीवन्मुक्तिर्न चैव हि ।
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन योगदृष्ट्या न किञ्चन ॥ १८-८०॥
transliteration:
na svargo naiva narako jīvanmuktirna caiva hi .
bahunātra kimuktena yogadṛṣṭyā na kiñcana .. 18-80..
translation: There is no heaven, nor hell, nor liberation while alive. What more is there to say? From the viewpoint of yoga, there is nothing.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: There is no heaven, nor hell, nor liberation while alive. What more is there to say? From the viewpoint of yoga, there is nothing.

sanskrit_shloka:
नैव प्रार्थयते लाभं नालाभेनानुशोचति ।
धीरस्य शीतलं चित्तममृतेनैव पूरितम् ॥ १८-८१॥
transliteration:
naiva prārthayate lābhaṃ nālābhenānuśocati .
dhīrasya śītalaṃ cittamamṛtenaiva pūritam .. 18-81..
translation: The wise one neither desires gain nor grieves at loss. His mind remains cool, filled with nectar-like bliss.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The wise one neither desires gain nor grieves at loss. His mind remains cool, filled with nectar-like bliss.

sanskrit_shloka:
न शान्तं स्तौति निष्कामो न दुष्टमपि निन्दति ।
समदुःखसुखस्तृप्तः किञ्चित् कृत्यं न पश्यति ॥ १८-८२॥
transliteration:
na śāntaṃ stauti niṣkāmo na duṣṭamapi nindati .
samaduḥkhasukhastṛptaḥ kiñcit kṛtyaṃ na paśyati .. 18-82..
translation: The desireless one does not praise the peaceful nor criticize the wicked. Content in both pleasure and pain, he sees nothing to be done.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The desireless one does not praise the peaceful nor criticize the wicked. Content in both pleasure and pain, he sees nothing to be done.

sanskrit_shloka:
धीरो न द्वेष्टि संसारमात्मानं न दिदृक्षति ।
हर्षामर्षविनिर्मुक्तो न मृतो न च जीवति ॥ १८-८३॥
transliteration:
dhīro na dveṣṭi saṃsāramātmānaṃ na didṛkṣati .
harṣāmarṣavinirmukto na mṛto na ca jīvati .. 18-83..
translation: The wise one neither hates the world nor desires to see the Self. Free from both joy and resentment, he neither lives nor dies.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The wise one neither hates the world nor desires to see the Self. Free from both joy and resentment, he neither lives nor dies.

sanskrit_shloka:
निःस्नेहः पुत्रदारादौ निष्कामो विषयेषु च ।
निश्चिन्तः स्वशरीरेऽपि निराशः शोभते बुधः ॥ १८-८४॥
transliteration:
niḥsnehaḥ putradārādau niṣkāmo viṣayeṣu ca .
niścintaḥ svaśarīre'pi nirāśaḥ śobhate budhaḥ .. 18-84..
translation: The wise one, free from attachment to family and possessions, free from desire for sense objects, free from concern for his own body, and without expectations, shines forth brilliantly.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The wise one, free from attachment to family and possessions, free from desire for sense objects, free from concern for his own body, and without expectations, shines forth brilliantly.

sanskrit_shloka:
तुष्टिः सर्वत्र धीरस्य यथापतितवर्तिनः ।
स्वच्छन्दं चरतो देशान् यत्रस्तमितशायिनः ॥ १८-८५॥
transliteration:
tuṣṭiḥ sarvatra dhīrasya yathāpatitavartinaḥ .
svacchandaṃ carato deśān yatrastamitaśāyinaḥ .. 18-85..
translation: Content everywhere, the wise one wanders freely from place to place, resting wherever the night falls, accepting whatever comes his way.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Content everywhere, the wise one wanders freely from place to place, resting wherever the night falls, accepting whatever comes his way.

sanskrit_shloka:
पततूदेतु वा देहो नास्य चिन्ता महात्मनः ।
स्वभावभूमिविश्रान्तिविस्मृताशेषसंसृतेः ॥ १८-८६॥
transliteration:
patatūdetu vā deho nāsya cintā mahātmanaḥ .
svabhāvabhūmiviśrāntivismṛtāśeṣasaṃsṛteḥ .. 18-86..
translation: Let the body fall or rise; the great soul has no concern. Resting in his true nature, he has forgotten the world entirely.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Let the body fall or rise; the great soul has no concern. Resting in his true nature, he has forgotten the world entirely.

sanskrit_shloka:
अकिञ्चनः कामचारो निर्द्वन्द्वश्छिन्नसंशयः ।
असक्तः सर्वभावेषु केवलो रमते बुधः ॥ १८-८७॥
transliteration:
akiñcanaḥ kāmacāro nirdvandvaśchinnasaṃśayaḥ .
asaktaḥ sarvabhāveṣu kevalo ramate budhaḥ .. 18-87..
translation: The wise one, possessing nothing, acting as he pleases, free from dualities and doubts, unattached to anything, enjoys himself alone.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The wise one, possessing nothing, acting as he pleases, free from dualities and doubts, unattached to anything, enjoys himself alone.

sanskrit_shloka:
निर्ममः शोभते धीरः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ।
सुभिन्नहृदयग्रन्थिर्विनिर्धूतरजस्तमः ॥ १८-८८॥
transliteration:
nirmamaḥ śobhate dhīraḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ .
subhinnahṛdayagranthirvinirdhūtarajastamaḥ .. 18-88..
translation: The wise one, who has severed the knots of his heart and shaken off passion and ignorance, shines, treating earth, stone, and gold as the same.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The wise one, who has severed the knots of his heart and shaken off passion and ignorance, shines, treating earth, stone, and gold as the same.

sanskrit_shloka:
सर्वत्रानवधानस्य न किञ्चिद् वासना हृदि ।
मुक्तात्मनो वितृप्तस्य तुलना केन जायते ॥ १८-८९॥
transliteration:
sarvatrānavadhānasya na kiñcid vāsanā hṛdi .
muktātmano vitṛptasya tulanā kena jāyate .. 18-89..
translation: The liberated and content one, inattentive to all things, with no desires in his heart, is beyond comparison with anyone.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: The liberated and content one, inattentive to all things, with no desires in his heart, is beyond comparison with anyone.

sanskrit_shloka:
जानन्नपि न जानाति पश्यन्नपि न पश्यति ।
ब्रुवन्न् अपि न च ब्रूते कोऽन्यो निर्वासनादृते ॥ १८-९०॥
transliteration:
jānannapi na jānāti paśyannapi na paśyati .
bruvann api na ca brūte ko'nyo nirvāsanādṛte .. 18-90..
translation: Though knowing, he does not know; though seeing, he does not see; though speaking, he does not speak. Who else but one without desires can be like this?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Though knowing, he does not know; though seeing, he does not see; though speaking, he does not speak. Who else but one without desires can be like this?

sanskrit_shloka:
भिक्षुर्वा भूपतिर्वापि यो निष्कामः स शोभते ।
भावेषु गलिता यस्य शोभनाशोभना मतिः ॥ १८-९१॥
transliteration:
bhikṣurvā bhūpatirvāpi yo niṣkāmaḥ sa śobhate .
bhāveṣu galitā yasya śobhanāśobhanā matiḥ .. 18-91..
translation: Whether a beggar or a king, one without desires shines if his notions of good and bad have vanished.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Whether a beggar or a king, one without desires shines if his notions of good and bad have vanished.

sanskrit_shloka:
क्व स्वाच्छन्द्यं क्व सङ्कोचः क्व वा तत्त्वविनिश्चयः ।
निर्व्याजार्जवभूतस्य चरितार्थस्य योगिनः ॥ १८-९२॥
transliteration:
kva svācchandyaṃ kva saṅkocaḥ kva vā tattvaviniścayaḥ .
nirvyājārjavabhūtasya caritārthasya yoginaḥ .. 18-92..
translation: For the accomplished yogi who is straightforward and without deceit, where is freedom, where is restriction, and where is certainty of truth?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: For the accomplished yogi who is straightforward and without deceit, where is freedom, where is restriction, and where is certainty of truth?

sanskrit_shloka:
आत्मविश्रान्तितृप्तेन निराशेन गतार्तिना ।
अन्तर्यदनुभूयेत तत् कथं कस्य कथ्यते ॥ १८-९३॥
transliteration:
ātmaviśrāntitṛptena nirāśena gatārtinā .
antaryadanubhūyeta tat kathaṃ kasya kathyate .. 18-93..
translation: What can be experienced within by one who is content in the Self, free from desires and suffering—how can that be explained to anyone?

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: What can be experienced within by one who is content in the Self, free from desires and suffering—how can that be explained to anyone?

sanskrit_shloka:
सुप्तोऽपि न सुषुप्तौ च स्वप्नेऽपि शयितो न च ।
जागरेऽपि न जागर्ति धीरस्तृप्तः पदे पदे ॥ १८-९४॥
transliteration:
supto'pi na suṣuptau ca svapne'pi śayito na ca .
jāgare'pi na jāgarti dhīrastṛptaḥ pade pade .. 18-94..
translation: Even when asleep, he is not in deep sleep; even when dreaming, he is not dreaming; even when awake, he is not awake. The wise one is satisfied at every step.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Even when asleep, he is not in deep sleep; even when dreaming, he is not dreaming; even when awake, he is not awake. The wise one is satisfied at every step.

sanskrit_shloka:
ज्ञः सचिन्तोऽपि निश्चिन्तः सेन्द्रियोऽपि निरिन्द्रियः ।
सुबुद्धिरपि निर्बुद्धिः साहङ्कारोऽनहङ्कृतिः ॥ १८-९५॥
transliteration:
jñaḥ sacinto'pi niścintaḥ sendriyo'pi nirindriyaḥ .
subuddhirapi nirbuddhiḥ sāhaṅkāro'nahaṅkṛtiḥ .. 18-95..
translation: Though thoughtful, the knower is carefree; though possessing senses, he is without senses. Though wise, he is without intellect; though possessing ego, he is without ego.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Though thoughtful, the knower is carefree; though possessing senses, he is without senses. Though wise, he is without intellect; though possessing ego, he is without ego.

sanskrit_shloka:
न सुखी न च वा दुःखी न विरक्तो न सङ्गवान् ।
न मुमुक्षुर्न वा मुक्ता न किञ्चिन्न च किञ्चन ॥ १८-९६॥
transliteration:
na sukhī na ca vā duḥkhī na virakto na saṅgavān .
na mumukṣurna vā muktā na kiñcinna ca kiñcana .. 18-96..
translation: He is neither happy nor sad, neither detached nor attached, neither desirous of liberation nor liberated. He is neither something nor nothing.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: He is neither happy nor sad, neither detached nor attached, neither desirous of liberation nor liberated. He is neither something nor nothing.

sanskrit_shloka:
विक्षेपेऽपि न विक्षिप्तः समाधौ न समाधिमान् ।
जाड्येऽपि न जडो धन्यः पाण्डित्येऽपि न पण्डितः ॥ १८-९७॥
transliteration:
vikṣepe'pi na vikṣiptaḥ samādhau na samādhimān .
jāḍye'pi na jaḍo dhanyaḥ pāṇḍitye'pi na paṇḍitaḥ .. 18-97..
translation: Even in distraction, he is not distracted; even in meditation, he is not meditating; even in dullness, he is not dull. Blessed is he, for even in learning, he is not a scholar.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Even in distraction, he is not distracted; even in meditation, he is not meditating; even in dullness, he is not dull. Blessed is he, for even in learning, he is not a scholar.

sanskrit_shloka:
मुक्तो यथास्थितिस्वस्थः कृतकर्तव्यनिर्वृतः ।
समः सर्वत्र वैतृष्ण्यान्न स्मरत्यकृतं कृतम् ॥ १८-९८॥
transliteration:
mukto yathāsthitisvasthaḥ kṛtakartavyanirvṛtaḥ .
samaḥ sarvatra vaitṛṣṇyānna smaratyakṛtaṃ kṛtam .. 18-98..
translation: Liberated, self-resting, fulfilled in his duties, he remains equal everywhere due to desirelessness, and he does not remember what is done or not done.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: Liberated, self-resting, fulfilled in his duties, he remains equal everywhere due to desirelessness, and he does not remember what is done or not done.

sanskrit_shloka:
न प्रीयते वन्द्यमानो निन्द्यमानो न कुप्यति ।
नैवोद्विजति मरणे जीवने नाभिनन्दति ॥ १८-९९॥
transliteration:
na prīyate vandyamāno nindyamāno na kupyati .
naivodvijati maraṇe jīvane nābhinandati .. 18-99..
translation: He does not feel pleasure when praised or anger when criticized. He is not disturbed by death nor delighted by life. He neither rejoices nor feels anxious.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: He does not feel pleasure when praised or anger when criticized. He is not disturbed by death nor delighted by life. He neither rejoices nor feels anxious.

sanskrit_shloka:
न धावति जनाकीर्णं नारण्यमुपशान्तधीः ।
यथातथा यत्रतत्र सम एवावतिष्ठते ॥ १८-१००॥
transliteration:
na dhāvati janākīrṇaṃ nāraṇyamupaśāntadhīḥ .
yathātathā yatratatra sama evāvatiṣṭhate .. 18-100..
translation: With a calm mind, he neither rushes into crowds nor retreats into the forest. Wherever and however he is, he remains steady and equanimous.

translations.author: English Translation
translations.text: With a calm mind, he neither rushes into crowds nor retreats into the forest. Wherever and however he is, he remains steady and equanimous.
